claims.title: Pay exact weakly-reversible class membership and conditional Poisson normalization

quoted_fields.interface: Finite weakly reversible mass-action network with positive rates, integer initial x0 and its actual reachable closed class Gamma; for normalization supplied positive rational c and0<delta<=1. No recurrence is inferred merely from ideal membership. Product-Poisson spectral applications assume the corresponding complex-balanced invariant law.
quoted_fields.failure: Reachability is imported Chandler–Heyworth math/0002119v1 at the coordinator-read Sections2–3/Thm3.9/Cor3.10 plus an explicit scope proof. Koppenhagen governing complexity thesis was not read/imported. Ordinary ideals must not be saturated or replaced by stoichiometry. Finite access to an invariant law does not decide positive physical-time Poincare gap, prove tail coercivity or an undecidability theorem.
